subject: Listing Adapters: Multi-cloud integration hooks & demo bundle
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Allen Park <allen@datalyft.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Listing Adapters: Multi-cloud integration hooks & demo bundle

Allen —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, DataLyft's connector will be the first external adapter we test across AWS, Azure, and GCP catalogs. To keep the listing intake clean I sketched a minimal "adapter" contract that would let a partner supply one artifact that maps to three marketplace listing formats.

High-level asks from our side:
- A short endpoint for auth & verification (JWT or OAuth2 client credentials)
- JSON manifest that lists SKUs, metering dimensions, and demo bundle URLs
- An S3/Blob accessible demo bundle (zipped) containing a runnable demo + README + short 3–4 minute walkthrough video
- A single evidence ZIP with the required security docs (SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, privacy statement)

I've attached a light spec and a demo-bundle checklist to make this actionable. Can you confirm DataLyft can produce the manifest and demo bundle by Jun 18? If not, propose a date and which items you need us to produce (e.g., signed NDA, test account, or staging credentials).

Operational notes:
- Olga, Vivek — please review the spec for gating items (metering tags, entitlement claims, and co-marketing assets).
- Our product team will spin up a staged listing in each cloud region once we have the manifest.

Next steps:
1) Allen confirms deliverables & timeline
2) DataLyft uploads demo bundle and evidence ZIP to provided staging bucket
3) Redwood runs validation script and returns a short report with any blockers

Thanks,
Ben

--
Ben Carter | Head of Partner GTM
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

From: Allen Park <allen@datalyft.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: SierraCloud procurement <procurement@sierracloud.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Jun 2028 11:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Listing Adapters: Multi-cloud integration hooks & demo bundle

Ben —

Appreciate the clear checklist. We can produce the manifest and demo bundle, but a couple clarifications:
1) Auth: we prefer OAuth2 client credentials; is a short-lived client creation workflow OK or do you need static creds for staging?
2) Metering dimensions: can you share the exact field names you expect (e.g., token_count vs. inference_units)?
3) Evidence ZIP: we have SOC2 type II report but redacted; is the summary doc sufficient?

Proposed timeline: manifest + demo bundle by Jun 20, evidence ZIP by Jun 25. Procurement on SierraCloud is CC'd — they asked for an estimated purchase order amount and whether any formal reseller paperwork is needed for multi-cloud listing fees.

If you can confirm the auth flow and field names I will lock the June 20 date and start packaging.

Thanks,
Allen Park
Director, Integrations | DataLyft
allen@datalyft.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Listing Adapters: Multi-cloud integration hooks & demo bundle

Ben / team —

Quick review from partner ops and technical certification POV:
- Auth: OAuth2 client credentials are preferred. We'll provide a short-lived client creation API for staging and a separate production onboarding flow for long-lived keys.
- Metering: please standardize to inference_units as the canonical field; we will map inference_units -> provider-specific token_count or compute_metered_seconds during ingestion. I'll add the mapping table to the spec (attached).
- Evidence: SOC2 summary is acceptable for the catalog intake; full report can be collected later for reseller/commercial approval.
- Demo bundle: vendor must include a scripted demo runbook and a CI job that exercises the manifest SKUs. This helps us flag packaging issues early.

Action items (owners):
- Olga: add mapping table and minimal validation script to the spec (attaching 'redwood-listing-adapter-spec.docx').
- Karthik: confirm whether legal needs a PO template for SierraCloud (they often require specific reseller language).
- Vivek: capture any strategic co-marketing assets we should request (case study checklist, logo bitmap).

I'll run the validation script on the first bundle and post a short triage doc if anything fails. If Allen's timeline holds we should be able to mark the intake as "staged" by Jun 22.

--
Olga Petrov | Partner Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

[attachment: redwood-listing-adapter-spec.docx (stub)]
